The '''Xifal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Xifal]],<ref name="Twitter" /> which was inhabited by members of the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Xifal system was first identified in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square S-6.
